papers.title_en: Agent Memory as Recommendation: Recommender-System Design for Long-Term Memory of LLM Agents
papers.authors: Xinyu Zhang, Weiwei Sun
papers.evidence: 将大语言模型助手的长期记忆选择建模为推荐问题
papers.tldr: 长期服务用户的智能体需要从不断增长的记忆库中，在有限上下文和成本预算下选齐跨会话证据。论文将这一过程形式化为预算约束下的列表推荐，提出结合候选召回、学习排序与列表构建的AgentMemRec，记忆选择无需调用大模型。在LongMemEval多会话问题上，其准确率较对比方法高10—31个百分点，匹敌每查询调用64次大模型的重排器，服务成本降至约三分之一。研究表明，收益主要来自更完整的证据组合，为长期记忆提供了高效设计框架。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents that serve users across many sessions must choose, for every request, the few stored memories that enter a limited context window. This choice largely decides whether the agent answers correctly, and it runs on every request at Web scale. This selection faces three challenges: a large and growing store, a per-request cost budget, and multi-session questions that need all of their evidence. Many memory systems build notes or graphs with hundreds to thousands of LLM calls per history, and each is designed on its own, so it is unclear which component yields the accuracy. These challenges mirror the properties of recommendation, so we formalize agent memory as budgeted slate recommendation, with the request as the user, stored memories as items and the context window as a slate. The formalization places memory systems in one design space of recommender cascades and factorizes accuracy into the completeness that each stage controls. Guided by it, we propose AgentMemRec, which adapts candidate generation, learning to rank and slate construction from recommender systems and selects memories without any LLM call. On multi-session questions of LongMemEval, AgentMemRec outperforms memory and context-selection methods, including A-Mem, HippoRAG 2, DynamicRAG and T-Mem, by 10 to 31 points of accuracy. It matches an LLM reranker that makes 64 calls per query at 3.2 times lower serving cost, and on LoCoMo it outperforms Mem0 and Zep without any LLM call at write time. The factorization attributes the gains to slates that more often hold all of the evidence, so recommender-system design offers an effective and efficient foundation for the long-term memory of LLM agents.

papers.title_en: Advisor, Co-pilot, or Guardian? AI Role Framing and Human Decision Behavior in Automated Vehicle Takeovers
papers.authors: Wei-Hsiang Lo, Jingyi Xie, Gaojian Huang
papers.evidence: 检验人机协作角色设定如何影响驾驶员接管决策
papers.tldr: 三级自动驾驶接管要求驾驶者在数秒内理解风险并决策，人工智能应以何种角色提供支持尚不明确。研究通过24人驾驶模拟实验，比较顾问、副驾驶与守护者三种角色，并考察解释类型和方向语义的影响。顾问决策最快，守护者工作负荷最低，两者准确率与满意度均优于副驾驶；解释类型的效果随角色变化，同侧语义比对侧语义更快。这些结果为接管系统的角色权限配置与语音提示设计提供了初步依据。
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) technology has gradually been integrated into automated vehicles. However, how this technology could systematically support takeover transitions in SAE Level 3 automated vehicles remains unknown, even though this level may remain a major form of driving automation in the near future. To address this, we implemented the three AI roles proposed by the triadic Human-AI collaboration framework (Advisor, Co-pilot, and Guardian) as potential authority-ability configurations for AI agents within an automated system. We then examined their interactions with explanation type (why and action) and directional semantics (ipsilateral and contralateral) in an automated driving simulator study with 24 participants. Results showed that, across the three AI roles, Advisor had the shortest decision-making time, followed by Guardian and Co-pilot. Advisor and Guardian were associated with higher decision-making accuracy and higher satisfaction ratings than Co-pilot. Guardian was associated with the lowest workload, followed by Advisor and Co-pilot. The effect of explanation type on decision-making time depended on AI role. Action explanations were faster under Advisor, whereas why explanations were faster under Co-pilot. For directional semantics, ipsilateral semantics were associated with shorter decision-making time than contralateral semantics. Overall, these findings provide preliminary guidance for designing AI-role authority-ability configurations and their associated speech-based takeover messages.

papers.title_en: LogicTree: Object-Oriented Writing for Structured Human-AI Academic Authoring
papers.authors: Jiajun Zhu, Xinyu Cheng, Wenshuo Zhang, Huamin Qu, Yanna Lin
papers.evidence: 以共享、可操作的写作结构支持人机协作
papers.tldr: 学术写作需要反复组织论点并维持全文逻辑，但线性对话式工具让作者承担重建结构、核对意图的负担。论文提出面向对象写作，以持久化层级写作对象作为人机共同操作的载体，并在集成Overleaf的LogicTree中结合结构化生成、问题驱动修订与逻辑审查。12人被试内研究初步表明，相比对话式基线，该系统有助于组织思路、降低工作负荷并提升测得的逻辑质量。这为以结构而非自由文本对话为中心的学术写作辅助提供了初步证据。
papers.abstract_en: Academic writing is non-linear, iterative, and structure-driven, requiring authors to develop fragmented ideas into arguments with local coherence and global consistency. However, current AI-assisted tools primarily exchange linear prompts and free-form text, forcing authors to reconstruct generated logic and repeatedly verify its alignment with their structural intentions. We propose object-oriented writing (OOW), an OOD-inspired representation and interaction paradigm in which persistent writing objects serve as shared, manipulable referents for authors and AI. We instantiate OOW in LogicTree, an Overleaf-integrated prototype that combines a hierarchical object representation with a structure-grounded writing assistance module for author-initiated generation and issue-grounded revision and a structural logical review module for inspecting local coherence and global consistency. A within-subjects study (N=12) provides initial evidence that, in controlled academic writing tasks, LogicTree helps users structure ideas, reduces workload, and improves measured logical quality compared with a conversational baseline.

papers.title_en: Generative AI as a Mediator in Creator Collaboration: Challenges, Design Opportunities, and Concerns
papers.authors: Hajun Kim, Jini Kim, Yunjae Josephine Choi
papers.evidence: 实证研究生成式人工智能如何促进创作者协作与共同理解。
papers.tldr: 生成式人工智能正从个人工具走向协同创作，但如何帮助不同专业创作者建立共同理解仍缺乏实证研究。研究以游戏开发为场景，对10名叙事作家和10名视觉设计师开展多方法研究。结果表明，人工智能可通过对齐创作意图、维持共享理解和缓解人际摩擦发挥协作中介作用，但也可能减少直接沟通、削弱互信并改变协作关系。论文据此提出设计机会，强调在增强协作的同时保留人的创造力与工作价值。
papers.abstract_en: As Generative AI (GenAI) expands beyond individual workflows and becomes increasingly integrated intocollaborative creative work, its potential to address the fundamental challenge of building common groundamong creators with diverse expertise remains underexplored. Specifically, we lack empirical understandingof how GenAI can mediate collaboration asymmetries among heterogeneous creators. To address this gap,we conducted a multi-method study with narrative writers (N = 10) and visual designers (N = 10) in thecontext of game development. Our findings demonstrate that GenAI goes beyond individual assistance toserve as a collaborative mediator by aligning creative intent, sustaining shared understanding, and mitigatinginterpersonal friction among creators. At the same time, we highlight concerns that GenAI may reducecommunication among creators, undermine mutual trust, and reshape interpersonal dynamics and collaborativeprocesses. Based on these insights, we identify design opportunities for GenAI tools that nurture collaborativesynergy while preserving the creativity and values of human work.

papers.title_en: Reversing Polarization through Tolerance-Aware Recommendation and Adaptive Diversification
papers.authors: Zhanzhan Zhao, Shuqi Zhao, Zichen Fan, Dana Randall
papers.evidence: 设计推荐策略拓宽观点接触，同时降低类似社交媒体信息流中的极化
papers.tldr: 推荐系统增加异见曝光可能触发排斥，单纯限制分歧又可能固化群体对立，因此需要区分延缓极化与逆转极化。论文结合个体分歧容忍度学习与自适应多样化，在避免超出容忍阈值的同时，为极端者拓宽曝光、为温和者保留较强个性化。基于吸引—排斥模型的仿真显示，组合策略能使极化低于初始水平，并在适当条件下恢复共识；百名大语言模型智能体的三次实验也均实现逆转。这为弥合既有群体分裂提供了机制层面的推荐设计思路。
papers.abstract_en: Recommender systems face a tension between broadening exposure to diverse viewpoints and avoiding interactions that reinforce extreme positions. This tension is especially consequential in already polarized populations. Here we investigate whether recommendation strategies can reverse polarization rather than merely slow its development. Building on the Attraction--Repulsion Model of opinion dynamics, we introduce two complementary design principles: Tolerance-aware recommendation, which seeks to learn each individual's tolerance for disagreement and reduces exposure to viewpoints beyond that tolerance, and adaptive diversification, which broadens exposure for agents with more extreme opinions while retaining stronger personalization for moderates. Agent-based experiments show that highly personalized recommendations intensify polarization under polarized initial conditions. Tolerance awareness alone primarily slows polarization, whereas combining it with adaptive diversification can reduce polarization below its initial level and, under suitable conditions, restore consensus. Additional experiments incorporating persistent extreme influencers and a spiral-of-silence mechanism show that the combined strategy can mitigate polarization under social pressure and selective participation. To examine whether these findings extend beyond predefined opinion-update rules, we repeat the experiments on a simulated social platform populated by 100 LLM-driven agents prompted to move toward opinions similar to their own and away from those that differ substantially. Across three runs, the combined strategy is again the only recommendation policy tested that reverses polarization in every run. These findings distinguish polarization prevention from reversal and identify tolerance-aware, adaptive exposure as a promising recommendation design principle for reconnecting divided populations.

papers.title_en: From Language to Drives: A Multimodal Framework for Aligning Autonomous Robots with Human Purposes
papers.authors: Diana Cerdas-Vargas, Alejandro Romero, Richard J. Duro
papers.evidence: 通过多模态交互过程，使自主机器人目标与人类意图对齐
papers.tldr: 开放式学习机器人能自主生成技能与目标，却缺乏使其持续符合人类目的的机制。本文利用大语言模型与视觉语言模型的通用及文化知识，通过语义对齐、任务生成和驱动力建模三层架构，将自然语言表达的人类目的转化为机器人任务与内部动机变量。系统结合多模态信息扩展可执行任务，并通过双向反馈维持意图对齐。仿真与实体机器人实验表明，该框架能够产生有效任务与行为，为自主机器人的交互式人类意图对齐提供实现路径。
papers.abstract_en: This work explores a multimodal approach to the alignment of the behavior of open-ended learning autonomous robots with human purposes through the use of large language models as cultural enablers. While autonomous robots can generate their own skills and goals through interaction with the environment, they often lack mechanisms to ensure that these remain relevant and aligned to those of human users. The proposed approach makes use of the general and cultural knowledge contained in LLMs and VLMs to establish a multimodal interactive alignment process in which human purposes, expressed in natural language, are transformed into motivational components of a robot architecture in the form of robot missions and drives that guide the behavior of the robot. The system is structured into three layers for semantic alignment, mission generation, and drive modeling. This design enables a bidirectional interaction loop: human inputs define high-level purposes, robots expand them into executable missions making use of multimodal information relayed by LLMs and VLMs, and feedback maintains alignment with human intent. Experiments in simulation and with a physical robot demonstrate that the process produces valid missions and behaviors, supporting effective human-agent alignment in interactive scenarios with autonomous robots.

papers.title_en: TrawMem: Reframing Agent Memory as Task-Oriented Role-Adaptive Workspaces
papers.authors: Mingyu Zhang, Zixu Li, Zhiheng Fu, Zhiwei Chen, Jinhe Bi, Yupeng Hu
papers.evidence: 将长期交互历史组织为面向任务的智能体记忆
papers.tldr: 现有智能体记忆系统主要按查询相关性检索，难以发现语义关联较弱但解题必需的互补信息。TrawMem将记忆重构为面向任务、角色自适应的工作空间，把交互历史组织成局部线程，并按任务角色与关系联合选择互补记忆。在两个基准、四种开闭源骨干模型上，宏平均F1提升2.23—3.14点；部分配置还减少上下文用量。其贡献是让记忆从被动提供相关证据，转向按解题需求组织协作的信息单元。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on memory systems to leverage long-term interactions, yet existing systems typically retrieve memories based on their relevance to the current query and use them as contextual evidence. However, relevance alone does not characterize how a memory contributes to task solving: the same memory may serve different roles across tasks, such as directly supporting the answer or linking to complementary memories with weaker semantic relevance but necessary information. We therefore reframe agent memory systems as Task-Oriented Role-Adaptive Workspaces, where memories are selected and organized by their task-oriented roles and relations. Based on this view, we propose TrawMem, which organizes interaction histories into local threads and constructs task-oriented workspaces by assigning roles and jointly selecting complementary memories. Experiments on LoCoMo and MemGallery with four open- and closed-source backbones show consistent improvements over representative memory systems, with macro-F1 gains of 2.23-3.14 points. On LoCoMo, TrawMem improves the LLM-Judge score over SimpleMem by 4.07 and 4.31 percentage points on Qwen3.5-9B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, respectively, while requiring approximately 12.8% and 5.1% fewer context tokens, respectively.

papers.title_en: EmoNet: A Lightweight Attention-Based CNN for Speech Emotion Recognition
papers.authors: Muhammad Moiz Khalid, Abdur Rehman Tariq, Muhammad Okasha Yamin
papers.evidence: 语音情绪识别可用于情感计算与心理健康评估
papers.tldr: 语音情感识别易受说话风格和声学条件影响，大型模型也难以适配资源受限场景。EmoNet面向七类情感，结合四块深度可分离卷积、通道注意力、残差连接、双向长短期记忆网络和多头注意力池化，并使用134通道声学特征与数据增强。在TESS、RAVDESS和SAVEE合并数据集上，模型以411万参数取得96.75%的测试准确率。结果展示了较小模型兼顾识别性能与参数效率的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) is a fundamental task in affective computing that enables applications such as mental health assessment, human-computer interaction, and automated customer support systems. Accurate emotion classification from speech remains challenging due to variations in speaker style, acoustic conditions, and the high computational cost of modern deep learning approaches. Many existing systems depend on large transformer-based architectures that require substantial computational resources, making them less suitable for real-time or resource-constrained environments. This research proposes EmoNet, a lightweight deep learning framework for speech emotion classification across seven emotion categories. The model is built on a four-block depthwise separable CNN encoder with squeeze-and-excitation attention and residual connections, combined with a Bidirectional LSTM for temporal feature learning and a multi-head attention pooling mechanism for improved representation. A comprehensive 134-channel acoustic feature set alongside data augmentation techniques including audio-level perturbations and SpecAugment is employed to improve robustness under diverse acoustic conditions. Evaluated on a combined dataset of TESS, RAVDESS, and SAVEE, EmoNet achieves a test accuracy of 96.75% with only 4.11 million parameters. The proposed model outperforms its reproduced baseline and remains competitive with significantly larger state-of-the-art architectures.

papers.title_en: How Humans Learn Unfamiliar Worlds: A Think-Aloud Dataset on ARC-AGI-3
papers.authors: Shuzhi Liu, Archana Warrier, Dat Nguyen, Chengqi Zheng, Kevin Ellis, Yewen Pu
papers.evidence: 记录人类交互操作与口述思考，并与大模型智能体轨迹对照。
papers.tldr: 理解通用智能，需要观察学习者如何探索陌生环境并修正世界模型，而不只比较通关分数。研究以ARC-AGI-3为平台，收集64名参与者在25款游戏中的144条同步操作与有声思考轨迹，并与250条大语言模型代理轨迹对照。成功轨迹中，人类采用定性表征的比例为50.0%，模型为14.3%；人类也更常开展无明确假设的探索。该数据集支持分析机制发现与错误恢复，并为强调证据积累、抽象和规划的新基准提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Learning through exploration and using newly acquired knowledge to achieve goals are central capabilities of general intelligence. Understanding these capabilities requires tracing how learners build, use, and revise world models during interaction. We construct the first dataset that records how humans discover and use the mechanisms of novel environments, using ARC-AGI-3 as a testbed: 144 trajectories from 64 participants across 25 public games, each pairing time-synchronized actions with think-aloud audio, plus 250 trajectories from large language model (LLM) agents with and without harnesses on the same games. We annotate mechanism triggers and recognition, action purposes, and errors and recovery, linking changes in understanding to the observations and actions that support them. We analyze characteristics of human cognition and compare them with those of LLM agents. Both groups anticipate mechanisms and use familiar analogies. Qualitative representations are more common in successful human trajectories than in successful LLM trajectories (50.0% versus 14.3%). Humans more often explore unfamiliar situations without a concrete hypothesis, while hypothesis testing is common in both groups. We also trace how learners recover through belief revision, replanning, and execution correction. As LLMs with well-designed harnesses reach saturated performance on public ARC-AGI-3 games, our cognitive analyses motivate next-generation benchmarks that challenge familiar priors, require accumulated evidence and abstraction, and test planning through subgoals, experimentation, and recovery. Our dataset is available at [https://arc3-human-think-aloud.github.io/](https://arc3-human-think-aloud.github.io/).

papers.title_en: Ask Before You Answer: A Question-Driven Evidence Reasoning Architecture (QERA) for In-Context Learning
papers.authors: Jinhu Qi, Minda Hu, Wentao Zhang, Zixing Song, Irwin King
papers.evidence: 提升个人助理利用用户记录与上下文完成任务的能力
papers.tldr: 真实聊天与活动记录中的任务常依赖早先约束，直接回答容易遗漏最终请求未重述的要求。QERA先生成需求清单与类型化问题，再结合完整对话作答，通过代码核验引文并进行受限局部修正。在405项任务、四个前沿模型上，平均解题率达21.0%，高于直接回答的14.6%和最强基线的18.2%。该方法无需训练，每项任务约调用模型四次，说明答前明确需求比单纯答后检查更有助于满足隐含要求。
papers.abstract_en: AI assistants are increasingly asked to reason over a user's own web traces: group chats, community threads, activity logs and revision histories. On CL-bench Life, a benchmark of such real-life context learning, frontier LLMs solve fewer than one task in five. We find that the request is not the specification: over 80% of the benchmark's rubrics share less than 60% of their content words with the final request, as for a rule set two turns earlier or every record that meets the user's criterion, and LLMs answering directly pass only 67% of these implicit rubrics against 81% of the others. We propose QERA, a Question-driven Evidence Reasoning Architecture that asks before it answers. QERA first turns the request into a requirement checklist and typed information needs, filtered by code for faithfulness to the user's words; it then answers from the whole conversation, asks the same questions again with quotes verified by code, and applies a guarded local repair. It needs no training or rubrics and makes about four LLM calls per task. On all 405 tasks with four frontier LLMs, QERA attains the highest solving rate on every LLM (21.0% on average, against 18.2% for the strongest of three inference-time baselines and 14.6% for direct answering) and leads every baseline significantly when pooled across LLMs, while using fewer tokens than PSCI and 4-5% of the tokens of Ctx2Skill. Ablations on GPT-6-Luna show that the gain is settled before the answer, by a fixed answer protocol (+3.8 rubric points) and the request-specific questions (+1.6), and that it is concentrated on implicit rubrics, with checking afterwards refining mainly numeric requirements.

papers.title_en: Gym-Anything-RT: Scaling Real-Time Environments for Vision-Language Agents
papers.authors: Pranjal Aggarwal, Sean Welleck
papers.evidence: 构建实时环境评估视觉语言智能体的交互能力
papers.tldr: 现有视觉语言智能体多在环境等待其决策的条件下评测，难以反映状态持续变化时的实时交互能力。Gym-Anything-RT依据六类能力，通过智能体流水线自动生成100个视觉小游戏，并支持实时、暂停和减速对照。GPT-6 Astra（xHigh）的通过率从实时条件下的9.0%升至暂停条件下的75.0%，显示显著能力落差。该基准及游戏公开发布，为研究实时交互瓶颈与代码绕过行为提供测试平台。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents have made substantial progress in domains where they have a non-trivial amount of time to deliberate between actions, such as mathematics, software engineering, and performing tasks on desktop applications. It is less clear how such models fare in settings that demand real-time interaction, such as playing a video game or operating a physical device. In these settings, the environment state may evolve as the agent is reasoning, or even as the underlying model is performing a forward pass. To gain insight into the real-time interaction capabilities of vision-language agents, we introduce Gym-Anything-RT. Our key idea is to construct visual minigames that demand a portfolio of capabilities required for interactive real-time settings. Gym-Anything-RT uses an agentic pipeline to automatically generate such environments based on a taxonomy of six capabilities required for real-time interaction, including the ability to perceive the environment and act under an evolving environment state. A key feature of Gym-Anything-RT is that it allows for controlled comparison of real-time interaction capabilities: we can run the same minigame in real time, or pause or slow down the environment to relax the requirement for real-time actions. We use Gym-Anything-RT to construct 100 real-time minigames and evaluate AI agents on them. We find large capability gaps in real-time interaction. For example, GPT-6 Astra (xHigh) achieves a pass rate of only 9.0% on the real-time minigames, which rises to 75.0% when the environment is paused. We also identify intriguing behaviors by the most powerful frontier agents: for instance, when given the ability to write code, these agents write code that bypasses the need to perceive and act in real time. We publicly release Gym-Anything-RT and the generated minigames to spur further research on AI agents in real-time interactive settings.

papers.title_en: Think Before You Act: Decision Gate for LLM Agents
papers.authors: Iftach Shoham, Yuval David, Offer Akrabi, Erez Bilgory, Ido Levy, Sami Marreed, Sergey Zeltyn, Segev Shlomov
papers.evidence: 执行前拦截智能体操作，进行策略核验并反馈纠正。
papers.tldr: 大语言模型智能体调用外部工具时，常缺少独立的执行前合规与完成度核验。JevAct在运行时拦截选定动作，将领域策略转为可执行状态检查和结构化问题，以确定性验证结合仅预填充决策模型的概率判断，并反馈纠错。在十一种智能体及航空、电信和函数调用基准上，电信与函数调用任务的可靠性提升更一致，航空结果较混合。该框架无需修改智能体参数或工具，为工具型智能体提供可插拔的执行前验证机制。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly perform consequential actions through external tools, yet their proposed actions are often executed without independent verification of policy compliance or task completion. We introduce JevAct, a runtime verification framework that intercepts selected agent actions before execution and enables feedback-driven correction. JevAct compiles domain policies into executable state checks and structured questions evaluated by a prefill-only decision model, which produces probability-based judgments without relying on LLM generation. By combining deterministic verification of tool-state facts with probabilistic assessment of conversational context, the framework identifies potentially invalid actions and premature task termination, providing targeted feedback for bounded revision. JevAct operates independently of the underlying agent model and requires no modifications to its parameters or tools. We evaluate JevAct across eleven LLM agents on $τ^2$-bench Airline and Telecom tasks and BFCL. Results show improvements in agent reliability across multiple models and benchmarks, with particularly consistent gains on Telecom and BFCL, while performance on Airline is more mixed. Overall, these findings suggest that combining structured decision models with executable verification can improve the reliability of tool-using LLM agents.

papers.title_en: EnvLunch: The Environment as a Free Lunch for Learning to Interact
papers.authors: Wei Liu, Min Gao, Yali Du, Yulan He
papers.evidence: 利用可执行数据库环境中的可验证轨迹训练语言模型智能体交互
papers.tldr: 数据分析智能体通常依赖大量标注任务学习与数据库交互，人工成本较高。EnvLunch在下游强化学习前加入无标注预热：采样有效动作轨迹并执行，仅给定最终观测，训练模型恢复功能等价的轨迹，无需人工或模型编写任务描述。其在各下游训练预算下平均提升超过9个百分点；少标注时，基线需用8至32倍标注样本才能匹配其最低预算表现。这表明环境本身可提供可验证监督，减少标注需求，并改善后续微调起点。
papers.abstract_en: For agentic data analysis, language-model agents often require a large number of annotated tasks to learn how to interact effectively with executable environments (i.e., databases). While high-quality annotated tasks require heavy manual effort, an executable environment already provides rich interaction structure and verifiable outcomes. In this sense, the environment itself offers a free lunch, an additional set of verifiable tasks that require no human annotation. We propose EnvLunch, a warm-up stage that turns this environmental signal into agent training without human-written or model-generated task descriptions, before downstream agentic reinforcement learning. EnvLunch samples valid action trajectories, executes them to obtain final observations, and trains an agent to recover a functionally equivalent trajectory given only its final observation. This label-free warm-up enables the model to outperform the baseline by over 9 points on average across all downstream training budgets, and with few labels, the baseline needs 8 to 32 times as many annotated examples to match the accuracy that the EnvLunch model reaches at its smallest training budget. Letting the environment alone define the task yields a larger gain than having the model write its own tasks over the same environments, and this warm-up also improves fine-tuning on benchmarks beyond data analysis. EnvLunch therefore saves annotated tasks and provides a better starting point for fine-tuning agentic models when such tasks are limited.

papers.title_en: Holding a Steady Course: Knowledge Evolution from Expertise and Lessons for Continual Agent Learning
papers.authors: Wenzhe Fan, Benjamin Steenhoek, Gaurav Mittal, Yu Hu
papers.evidence: 为智能体持续积累可复用技能与纠错经验
papers.tldr: 智能体在连续处理相关任务时，往往难以保留并改进知识，直接积累轨迹还可能传播错误。KEEL利用验证器证据，将成功行为提炼为可复用技能，将失败转化为纠错教训，并随新证据支持、反驳、替换或退役具体技能主张。在SkillFlow上，其任务成功率较无知识基线提升4.2至21.7个百分点，消融实验显示技能与教训互补。研究表明，持续学习的关键不只是积累经验，更是持续验证与演化知识。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents are increasingly deployed across sequences of related tasks, yet they often fail to retain and improve their knowledge over time. Existing approaches convert interaction trajectories into memories or reusable skills, but experience is not automatically reliable knowledge. Automatically collected skills and memories can propagate errors, mislead, and corrupt useful knowledge. To address this gap, we introduce Knowledge Evolution from Expertise and Lessons (KEEL), an agent-agnostic framework that uses verifier evidence to transform successful behavior into reusable skills and failures into corrective lessons. As new evidence accumulates, individual skill claims can be supported, contradicted, replaced, or retired. On SkillFlow benchmark, KEEL improves task success by 4.2 to 21.7 percentage points over the no-knowledge baseline, compared with gains of 2.4 to 9.6 points from SkillFlow's default method. Ablations show that skills and lessons are complementary. These results show that reliable continual agent learning depends not simply on accumulating experience, but on continually validating and evolving the knowledge derived from it. Our code is available at: https://github.com/microsoft/KEEL-TTCL26.

papers.title_en: DynaFlow: Learning Free-Form Multi-Agent Orchestration
papers.authors: Ruhao Liu, Qi Li, Shizun Wang, Xinchao Wang
papers.evidence: 通过动态合成协作工作流协调多个智能体
papers.tldr: 多智能体系统常依赖预设协作结构，难以适应不同任务。DynaFlow将自由形式的可执行工作流生成纳入主智能体动作空间，使其按需组织子智能体，支持串并行执行、信息交换和验证，并依据执行反馈调整协作。训练仅更新主智能体，保持子智能体固定。在六项基准上，强制协作模式总体准确率达88.08%，较同骨干最强基线提高10.90个百分点。研究表明，跨阶段信息利用与验证是提升编排能力的重要维度。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems often rely on predefined collaboration structures, limiting their ability to adapt to diverse task requirements. We introduce DynaFlow, a framework that integrates free-form executable workflow synthesis into the action space of the main agent. The agent decides when collaboration is needed and generates task-specific programs that coordinate sub-agents through sequential or parallel execution, structured information exchange, and verification. Execution results and traces inform subsequent actions, enabling the agent to adapt collaboration as reasoning progresses. We train only the main agent through supervised fine-tuning on distilled trajectories, followed by refinement on examples filtered for unsupported premises, biased verification, and information-flow defects. All sub-agents remain fixed, separating orchestration learning from executor capability improvement. Across six benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, scientific question answering, and multi-hop retrieval, DynaFlow achieves 88.08% overall accuracy in Forced mode, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 10.90 percentage points with the same Qwen3.5-27B backbone. Workflow analysis finds more explicit use, verification, and refinement of upstream outputs after training, highlighting cross-stage information flow as a key dimension of multi-agent orchestration.

papers.title_en: High Scores, Hidden Failures: Evaluating Codebook-Based LLM Content Analysis
papers.authors: Elena Senger, Yuri Campbell, Rob van der Goot, Barbara Plank
papers.evidence: 评估大语言模型社会科学内容分析的可靠性与概念有效性
papers.tldr: 大语言模型已被用于依据编码手册开展内容分析，但较高的总体得分并不意味着标注可靠。研究覆盖四个数据集和五个模型，通过受控扰动、领域迁移及优化过程，检验标注稳定性、鲁棒性与概念效度。结果发现，高分下仍存在标签间表现悬殊、重复运行不稳定、领域敏感及标签含义偏移，且常见优化策略无法消除这些问题。研究强调，将此类流程作为社会科学测量工具前，必须开展超越准确率和微平均F1的针对性验证。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for codebook-based content analysis in computational social science, where codebooks translate theoretical concepts into labeling schemes. While prior work reports strong predictive performance, it remains unclear whether these systems produce reliable and robust text annotations. We conduct a large-scale empirical failure-mode analysis of LLM-based coding pipelines across four datasets and five models by systematically evaluating their stability, robustness, and conceptual validity under controlled perturbations, domain shifts, and optimization procedures. We uncover multiple failure modes that are largely invisible under standard metrics, showing that high aggregate scores frequently coexist with severe label-level disparities, instability across runs, domain sensitivity, and shifts in label interpretation. Importantly, these failure modes persist under widely used optimization strategies and remain largely invisible under standard metrics such as accuracy and micro-F1. Our results demonstrate that current LLM-based coding pipelines cannot be treated as stable measurement tools without targeted validation beyond aggregate performance.

papers.title_en: Beyond Federated Learning: Decentralized Agentic Systems for Self-Evolving Clinical Intelligence
papers.authors: Haoyuan Li, Mathias Funk, Aaqib Saeed
papers.evidence: 提出分布式临床智能体协作框架，与人工智能临床决策支持相关。
papers.tldr: 临床知识分散在不同机构的诊疗经验中，现有医疗人工智能与联邦学习主要聚合数据或参数，难以充分利用这些经验。本文提出去中心化智能体系统，让跨机构智能体共享抽象推理轨迹，包含观察、假设、工具调用和结局反馈，而非原始数据或模型参数。作为观点论文，文章讨论架构原则、部署、治理与开放挑战，未报告实证性能结果。其贡献是提出从数据聚合转向经验聚合的协作框架，为面向纵向患者照护、持续适应的临床智能提供研究方向。
papers.abstract_en: Clinical expertise is inherently distributed: it resides not in any single dataset or institution but in the accumulated reasoning experiences of thousands of clinicians navigating diverse patient populations, resource constraints, and evolving treatment protocols. Yet current approaches to scaling medical AI, from centralized large language models to federated learning, remain anchored to a data-centric paradigm that treats knowledge as static parameters to be aggregated. In this Perspective, we argue for a fundamental shift from data aggregation to experience aggregation. We propose Decentralized Agentic Systems (DAS), a framework in which distributed AI agents operating across healthcare institutions synthesize collective clinical intelligence by sharing abstracted reasoning trajectories rather than raw data or model parameters. Unlike federated learning, which averages numerical gradients across homogeneous model architectures, DAS exchanges structured records of clinical reasoning, specifically the sequence of observations, hypotheses, tool invocations, and outcome feedback that constitute diagnostic experience. We examine the architectural principles, deployment considerations, governance requirements, and critical open challenges of this framework, laying the groundwork for a collaborative medical AI ecosystem where distributed expertise autonomously adapts to the complexities of longitudinal patient care.

papers.title_en: CoHARL: Co-Evolving Agent Policies and Executable Harnesses with Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Jianwen Chen, Peng Xia, Kaide Zeng, Siwei Han, Zhen-Yu Zhang, Charles Fleming, Xinyu Ye, Huaxiu Yao
papers.evidence: 在强化学习中共同优化智能体策略及其工具交互接口
papers.tldr: 大语言模型智能体的表现同时受策略与可执行交互框架影响，只优化一方难以适应训练中另一方的变化。CoHARL通过强化学习共同演化共享策略与框架种群，策略从多个框架的交互轨迹中学习，提议器则依据执行轨迹持续修订框架代码。其在SWE-rebench上的平均解决率达27.6%，较仅搜索框架提高6.4个百分点，并在软件工程和终端任务中取得增益。结果支持将执行接口作为训练期间持续优化的对象，而非固定配置。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents interact with their environments through executable harnesses that govern tool use and feedback. Optimizing a harness for a fixed policy overlooks how its behavior changes during learning, while training a policy under a fixed harness leaves the interface that generates its training experience unchanged. This motivates adapting the harness throughout policy training. We introduce CoHARL, a population-based reinforcement learning framework that co-evolves a shared policy and a population of executable harnesses. The policy learns from rollouts across the population, and a proposer uses its execution traces to revise harness code during training. CoHARL achieves a 27.6% mean resolved rate on SWE-rebench, improving over harness-only search by 6.4 percentage points. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.0 show gains in software engineering and terminal-based tasks. Under matched training budgets, CoHARL also outperforms searching for a harness once before RL and alternating policy updates with revisions to a single active harness.

papers.title_en: Game-Theoretic Solvers with Bayesian Opponent Modeling and Moral Rhetoric Framing for GLEE
papers.authors: Hayden Arnold
papers.evidence: 智能体通过语言模型与人类及AI对手谈判和劝说
papers.tldr: 面向人类与人工智能混合对手，经典博弈最优策略常因对手偏离理论假设而失效。该智能体以经典求解器制定数值决策，结合在线贝叶斯对手建模、汤普森采样修辞选择与语言模型生成消息。在13200局模拟和9337条实战消息分析中，作者评估了适应机制，并发现道德修辞框架与购买行为显著相关。研究呈现了理论策略落地的失败模式与防护机制，但相关性结果不能直接解释为修辞的因果效果。
papers.abstract_en: We describe the agent we submitted to the GLEE Competition, which plays bargaining, negotiation, and persuasion games against a shared pool of human and AI opponents. The agent is built around three central components: a classical game-theoretic solver to compute numeric moves, an online Bayesian layer to estimate opponent archetypes, and a language model to write accompanying messages. We utilize Rubinstein bargaining for bargaining, Faratin concession for negotiation, and Kamenica--Gentzkow disclosure for persuasion, and adapt those models to live opponents using two separate layers: a Bayesian estimate of the opponent's hidden discount factor, reservation value, or signaling reliability, and a Thompson sampling bandit over five moral-foundation framings coupled with an evidence-intuition spectrum to establish message register. Most of the development effort went into the recurring problem that theoretically optimal policies perform poorly in certain live settings; we report associated failure modes, guardrails we built, and our hypotheses. We additionally evaluate our model over 13,200 Monte Carlo games against 11 synthetic opponent archetypes, an ablation of the opponent-modeling layer, and an extensive analysis of 9,337 live-game messages in which moral rhetoric framing in the persuasion setting is strongly correlated with whether the buyer purchased ($χ^2=616.7$, $p \approx 3.7\times10^{-132}$), surviving controls for quality, round, and configuration.

papers.title_en: Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI: Mechanisms, Evidence, and Evaluation
papers.authors: Xiaofeng Han, Kaize Luo, Zenghuang Fu, Zichong Zhu, Zhe Feng, Changwei Wang, Rongtao Xu, Weiliang Meng, Xiaopeng Zhang
papers.evidence: 综述具身智能如何利用部署经验、反馈与交互持续改进。
papers.tldr: 具身系统可从部署经验中持续提升能力，但策略更新不等于递归自我改进。本文综述策略学习、想象经验、记忆与技能积累及可执行框架，区分学习器更新与改进过程修订，并以四级标准梳理证据。论文提出从相同学习器起点开展共享数据与交互式比较，区分经验利用和经验获取的贡献，同时关注接触有效性、恢复、保持与资源成本。其贡献是建立统一的机制与评估视角，而非报告新的性能突破。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied systems can update policies, world models, skills, and executable programs from deployment experience, allowing one interaction to benefit later tasks. When a system also revises and reuses its data-acquisition, feedback, or learning procedures, experience changes the process that produces capability, introducing recursive self-improvement. This paper surveys research in physical AI through the connection between persistent capability and its improvement process. We first explain the functional distinction between learner updates and improvers, then compare policy learning, imagined experience, memory and skill accumulation, and executable harnesses. These approaches connect to revisions of curricula, rewards, and research programs in different ways. Contact validity, recovery, retention, and resource costs determine whether the resulting gains accumulate during continued deployment. An L0-L3 rubric distinguishes task-local adaptation, persistent capability gain, inherited process revision, and verified improver gain. Representative benchmarks and within-study contrasts relate these distinctions to existing results. We further propose common-data and interactive comparisons that evaluate reference and revised improvers from shared learner starts, separating the use of experience from its acquisition. This perspective connects the diverse methods, physical operating conditions, and evaluation evidence, underpinning embodied RSI. A comprehensive list of studies in this survey is available at https://github.com/nkd-lkz/physical-ai-rsi-survey.

papers.title_en: AtomTree: A Hierarchical Framework for State-Aware Embodied Instruction Following with LLMs
papers.authors: Haotian Zhai, Tianming Sha, Junnan Li
papers.evidence: 提出依据交互环境当前状态逐步更新计划的语言模型智能体。
papers.tldr: 具身指令跟随需要在交互环境中完成长程任务，但现有大模型规划常一次性生成完整计划，对执行状态变化适应不足。AtomTree逐步构建子目标与动作树，依据当前符号状态决定继续分解任务或输出低层动作，并用轻量记忆复用历史执行结果。当动作停滞时，框架回溯至父节点，基于最新状态重新生成子树计划。在ALFRED零样本评测中，该方法优于此前的大模型规划器，展示了状态感知与分层重规划的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied instruction following in interactive environments requires agents to interpret natural language commands and complete long-horizon tasks. Existing planners either rely on large labeled trajectories, or use few-shot and zero-shot LLM prompting that produces a whole plan in a single serial reasoning process. These approaches depend on linguistic common sense, commit to a plan from the initial instruction, and only update after failures, which weakens robustness and state awareness. We present AtomTree, a hierarchical framework for state-aware task planning with LLMs. AtomTree incrementally builds a tree of subgoals and actions, where the LLM decides at each step, from the current symbolic state, whether to further decompose or to output a grounded low-level action. A lightweight memory module summarizes past outcomes for reuse in later decisions. When a low-level action stalls, AtomTree triggers hierarchical backtracking replanning to return to the parent node and regenerate the subtree plan from the latest state, preventing continued drift along an incorrect trajectory. In zero-shot evaluation on the ALFRED benchmark, AtomTree outperforms prior LLM-based planners. Project page: https://zhaihaotian.github.io/atomtree-website/.

papers.title_en: Auditable Belief Updates as a Missing Safety Layer for LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Zhuoyun Li, Boxuan Wang, Jinwei Hu, Xiaowei Huang, Yi Dong
papers.evidence: 提出可审计的信念更新机制，增强多智能体系统的安全与监督
papers.tldr: 大模型多智能体系统的安全风险不仅来自有害输出，也来自错误认知承诺在检索、记忆、工具与智能体通信中的累积传播。论文提出显式信念多智能体系统，将指导行动的信念外置为结构化状态，通过信念算子提出更新，再由认知防火墙限制或拒绝证据薄弱、却受脆弱性线索强烈驱动的更新。论文进一步讨论人为共识、串通和错误信息级联等群体风险，但摘要未报告实验验证。其贡献是将安全治理从输出过滤扩展到运行时可追踪、可校准、可约束的信念修订。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being used as cognitive interfaces that shape how users interpret evidence, communicate, and make decisions. As deployed systems become more multimodal, tool-using, and multi-agent, safety failures no longer arise only from isolated harmful outputs, but also from how agents update, store, and propagate epistemic commitments across retrieval, memory, tools, and peer communication. In this paper, we define belief as an engineering abstraction for evidence-based commitments that guide downstream action. Building on this view, we propose the Explicit Belief Multi-Agent System (EB-MAS), which externalizes belief states into a structured substrate, uses belief operators to propose candidate updates, and applies a Cognitive Firewall to bound or reject updates that are weakly evidenced but strongly driven by vulnerability cues. We also discuss the risk of group belief at the group level, including manufactured consensus, collusion, and cascading misinformation, and outline practical integration challenges around grounding, false positives, scalability, and ethical misuse. Therefore, scalable agent safety requires not only better output filtering or stronger base models, but also explicit interfaces for tracing, calibrating, and constraining belief revision at runtime.

papers.title_en: PCM: A Proof-Carrying Message Protocol for Verifiable Multi-Agent Communication
papers.authors: Bravish Ghosh
papers.evidence: 以可验证消息协议降低智能体间虚假声明传播风险
papers.tldr: 多智能体协议能认证通信渠道，却无法保证发送方所述事实与权限真实。PCM让声明携带代理无法写入的追加式默克尔日志记录、包含证明及独立签名，并离线判定已证明、未证明或失败；授权链以人类批准为根且只能收窄。在926条消息、其中712条虚假声明的基准上，PCM仅接受10条虚假声明，均源于过时证据，验证约需1毫秒。它将信任依据从代理自述转向独立证据，但仍不能保证历史事实代表当前状态。
papers.abstract_en: When one AI agent tells another that "the tests passed" or "a person approved this refund", the receiver has only the sender's word. A2A and MCP authenticate the channel, but the sender is the party in doubt, so a prompt-injected agent can launder fabricated facts and authority through a multi-agent system. We present Proof-Carrying Messages (PCM), a protocol in which each claim carries evidence: records from an append-only Merkle log that the agent cannot write, with inclusion proofs, signed by an attesting signer the agent cannot control. Receivers check messages offline and give each claim a three-valued result: proven, unproven or failed. A claim that rests only on the agent's own report is never proven. Authority travels as grant chains rooted in a recorded human approval, and the chains can only narrow. We specify four claim types, a typed caveat algebra, replay rules that survive restarts, and strict readings that make independent verifiers agree, and we prove the resulting security properties. On a pre-specified benchmark of 926 messages from real runs, 712 of them lies in 16 classes, PCM accepts 10 lies, all of them stale evidence (1.4%, 95% CI 0.8-2.6%). Plain A2A accepts all 712, and models of six deployed protocols (A2A with signed Agent Cards, uAgents, RFC 9421, SCITT, AP2, Verifiable Intent) accept 504-712. Two independent verifiers agree on all 926 verdicts, and verification takes about 1 ms.

papers.title_en: Trajeform: Embedding Crowd Data
papers.authors: Marilena Lemonari, Panayiotis Charalambous, Yiorgos Chrysanthou
papers.evidence: 评估学习到的群体行为是否贴近真实人群，而不只比较轨迹
papers.tldr: 现有人群仿真评估多关注轨迹误差，难以衡量模拟行为与真实人群的相似性。Trajeform在真实轨迹上训练重构型变分自编码器，学习保留行为特征的连续嵌入，再比较真实与合成轨迹的潜在分布。对CCP、modCCP和RVO的定量与定性分析表明，该空间能够捕捉真实数据中有意义的轨迹依赖关系。该框架为合成数据可信度提供补充评估，并可分析额外数据对真实行为空间的覆盖，为后续轨迹模型训练提供参考。
papers.abstract_en: Crowd simulation aims to generate agent behaviours that are rich, natural, and appropriate to their surrounding environment. Recent advances in Machine Learning have enabled such behavioural patterns to be learned directly from trajectory data, allowing simulation models to capture increasingly complex crowd dynamics. However, the capabilities of these systems remain strongly dependent on the type and diversity of the data used during training. When evaluating how well crowd simulators generalise to real-world datasets, most existing metrics focus primarily on trajectory-level differences rather than behaviour-level similarity. In this paper, we present Trajeform, a framework that trains a reconstruction VAE (Variational Autoencoder) on real trajectory data to learn a meaningful continuous embedding that preserves behavioural characteristics of real crowds. The trained encoder can then be applied to synthetic trajectories generated by simulators and used to compare the resulting embedding distributions. Additionally, the learned embedding can be used to analyse supplementary data, such as trajectories corresponding to a simulator's principal behaviours or captured data from controlled environments (e.g., cycling), providing insight into their ability to span the real behavioural embedding space. The framework compares data from three simulators (CCP, modCCP, and RVO) against ground-truth datasets and is evaluated quantitatively and qualitatively using latent-space analysis, distributional metrics, and trajectory generation through sampling from the aggregated posterior distribution. The results indicate that the learned latent space captures meaningful trajectory dependencies found in the real data, making the framework useful both as an additional measure of synthetic data believability and as a tool for informing the training of future trajectory models.

papers.title_en: R2QRec: Learning Recommendation Queries from Retrieval Feedback
papers.authors: Weixin Chen, Shuchang Liu, Hailan Yang, Yuhan Zhao, Li Kang, Xuefeng Zhang, Chenghao Zhang, Xinyuan Wang, Hanchen Yang, Yinghao Wu, Hua Huang, Yandong Bai, Fan Yang, Xiang Li, Chunjie Chen, Li Chen
papers.evidence: 利用检索结果反馈，从用户与物品交互记录中学习推荐查询。
papers.tldr: 查询式推荐将用户需求表达与物品检索分离，但交互日志缺少查询标注，难以学习有效的检索请求。R2QRec先用固定检索器验证生成查询，筛选能找回已交互物品的表达进行监督微调；再根据多查询融合列表中目标物品的排名优化生成策略。该方法在三个公开数据集上取得参评方法中整体最优的推荐表现，并展现跨生成器与领域的泛化能力。其贡献是将检索反馈同时用于构造监督和优化排序，无需人工查询标注或学习奖励模型。
papers.abstract_en: Query-based recommendation separates expressing user needs from locating matching items. Its central learning problem is how to turn item interactions into effective retrieval requests when interaction logs do not annotate queries. We present R2QRec, which uses a fixed retrieval system to construct query supervision and evaluate recommendation outcomes. Retrieval verification first selects generated expressions that recover observed items as supervised fine tuning targets, allowing retrieval behavior to determine the target wording. Policy refinement then evaluates generated query sets by the observed item's rank in their fused recommendation list. Log-rank feedback distinguishes outcomes beyond the recommendation cutoff, while a KL penalty constrains policy change relative to the supervised reference. The stages have distinct roles: verification identifies expressions to imitate, and policy refinement improves the combined ranking produced by newly generated queries. Only the query generator is trained; the retriever and item index remain fixed, and no query annotations or learned reward model are required. Across three public datasets, R2QRec achieves state-of-the-art overall recommendation performance among the evaluated methods. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed design and its generalization across generators and domains.
